name: In Patch Group
description: A managed instance is in a patch group (managed instance -> patch group): its last patch operation (DescribeInstancePatchStates) names the group as PatchGroup, and DescribePatchGroups lists the group (ruling Q139b). An instance naming a group no baseline is registered for has no edge; its patch_group field keeps the name. A reference, not containment. Collected by the SSM baseline walk (collectors/boto3_collector/ssm_baselines.py, aws-core-tap#281, req-aws-core-ssm-baselines).
